newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish Jan oil products sales unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Finnish Jan oil products sales unchanged.

text.p: Sales in Finland of refined oil products were unchanged year-on-year in January at 714,000 tonnes, the Finnish Petroleum Association said on Thursday.
Oil product sales for the 12 months to end-January were up less than three percent on the previous year, it said in a statement.

Sales of motor petroleum rose 20 percent year-on-year in January, but the growth was explained by the low level of petrol sales in January 1996 due to stockpiling at the end of 1995, the association said.
In 1996 petroleum sales fell three percent, and sales for the 12 months to end-January were still about 1.5 percent lower than in the year-ago period, it said.
Diesel sales rose in 1996 due to economic growth, and January sales were about 11 percent higher than in the year-ago period, the association said.
